decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The external elements of the equipment hereby approved shall have a matt finish and shall be coloured to match the existing brick wall as closely as possible.  It shall be permanently maintained as such

Condition : 4 - If the proposed flue is to be constructed other than of galvenised steel, details of measures to protect it from vandalism, shall be submitted to and approved by, the Local Planning Authority. Such measures shall be implemented in full within two weeks of the flue having been first erected. These measures shall be retained so long as the flue itself is retained.
Condition : 5 - The ventilation equipment hereby approved shall not be operated between the hours of 10.30 pm and 10.00 am on Sundays and between 10:30 pm and 8:00 am on other days of the week.
description: Installation of an extracter system to rear of existing premises. (Amended plans received 08/12/2004 and please note change of reference)
